paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ni khat Saul tapa Jonathan in agalvan tawipa tangval kiang ah, "Kisa dih, gal langkhat a Philistia mi galvil sepaihte omna ah i va hoh ding," achi hi. Himahleh apa ahilh kei hi.
heading: Jonathan Thilhih Hangsan

paite: Saul bel Gibeah gam tawp lam pek a Migron a theibuhfai kung nuai ah a-om hi. Akiang a om mite zaguk ahi uh.
Shiloh a TOUPA siampu Eli tapa Phinehas tapa Ikabod unaupa Ahitub tapa Ahijah siampu puanak silh a-om hi. Jonathan ahoh chih mipite'n athei kei uhi.
Jonathan in Philistia mi galvil sepaihte omna a hoh atupna phaizang leh phaizang kikal ah alang tuaktuak ah suangpi sangtak a-om hi. Akhat min Bozez ahi a, akhat min Seneh ahi.
Suangpi sang khat pen Mikmash zawn mallam a om ahi a, adang khat pen Gebeah zawn simlam a om ahi.

Jonathan in agalvan tawipa tangval kiang ah, "Kisa dih, zeksum louh sepaihte omna ah i va hoh ding. TOUPA'N thil ahon hihsak kha mai hiam. TOUPA a ding in atam hiam, atawm hiam ahotdamna ding bangmah dalna a-om tuan ngal kei a," achi hi.
Agalvan tawipa'n akiang ah, "Na lungsim a om bangtak in hih in. Ngai in, na lungsim bang geih ka lungsim ahi," achi hi.
Huchi in Jonathan in, "Kisa in, akiang uah i va hoh galkah dia, i va kimusak ding.
I kiang a, 'Na kiang ua ka hong matan uh na om un, ahon chih uleh i mun ah i dingh kinken dia, akiang uah i hohtou kei ding.'
"Ka kiang lam uah hong tou un, achih uleh bel i hohtou dia, TOUPA'N i khut ah amaute ahon pia chih ei a ding in chiamtehna ahi ding," achi hi.
Anih un Philistia mi galvil sepaihte ava kimusak uhi. Philistiate'n, "En dih uh, Hebru mite abukna leihawm a pan ahong paikhia uh," achi uhi.

Galvil sepaihte omna a mite'n Jonathan leh agalvan tawipa, "Hong paitou unla, thil banghiam ka hon ensak ding uh," chi in ana sam uhi. Jonathan in agalvan tawipa kiang ah, "Hon zuitou dih. TOUPA'N amaute Israelte khut ah apeta hi," achi hi.
Jonathan akhut leh khe toh pang in akaltou a, agalvan tawipa'n azui hi. Amau bel Jonathan ma ah apuk ua, ama nung in agalvan tawipa'n amaute athat hi.
Jonathan leh agalvan tawipa'n athah masakpen uh mi sawmnih vel, lou chiing khat, bawngtal nih leilehna chia sung ahi.
Giahmun leh gamlak a mipi tengteng aling ua; galvil sepaihte leh lok mite leng aling sam uh. Huan ziin ahong ling a; huchi in nakpitak a linna a-om hi.
Benjamin gam Gibeah ah Saul galvil mite'n a-en vialvial uhi. Ngai in, mipite zul in azulkhe zungzung ua, khat lam khat lam ah akiphutuah muimui uhi.
heading: Philistiate Tung A Vualzohna

paite: Huchi in Saul in akiang a mipi omte kiang ah, "Tu in kisim unla, kuate ahia kim lou hong ki-en dih ua," achi hi. Ahong kisim uleh ngai in, Jonathan leh agalvan tawipa ana om kei uhi.
Saul in Ahijah kiang ah, "Pathian bawm va la dih," achi hi. Huai lai in Pathian bawm Israel suante kiang a om ahi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Saul in siampu ahoupih laitak in Philistia mite giahmun lam a thawmging angaih semsem hi. Saul in siampu kiang ah, "Na khut kaikik in," achi hi.
Huchi in Saul leh akiang a mipi om tengteng apaikhawm ua, kidouna ah ahohta uh. Ngai in, amau leh amau namsau in ana kisattuah ua, huchi in apumbuai uhi.
Hiai ban ah tuma lam a Hebru mite huai gam kim a pan Philistiate giahmun a amau toh va paitoute leng Saul leh Jonathan kiang a om in Israel mite lam ah ahong pang nawnta uhi,
Huchi mah bang in Ephraim tanggam a Israel mi kibu tengteng in Philistia mite ataimang uh chih ana za ua, amau leng kidouna a pang sam in adelhzui uhi.
Huchi in huai ni in TOUPA'N Israelte ahumbitta hi. Beth-aven pha in asual uhi.

Huai ni in Israel mite alungkia ua, Saul in, "Ka melmate tung a phu ka lakna dia nitaklam ahih masiah kuapeuh in an anekleh hamsia thuak hen," achih ziak in. Huchi in kuamah in an himhim achiam kei uhi.
heading: Kidou Khit A Thil Tungte

paite: Mipi tengteng gamnuai ava tung ua, lei ah khuaizu ana om hi.
Mipite gamnuai ava tun un, ngai in, khuaizu ana takkhia hi. Himahleh mipite'n hamsia alauh ziak un kuama'n khut a sawk in achiam ngam kei uhi.
Himahleh apa'n mipite kichiam a, vau ahih lam Jonathan in thei lou in akhut a chiangmong in khuaikhak adawt a, akam a guang in aneta a, huchi in amit hah ahong chiangta hi.
Mipi lak a mi khat in ahoupih a, "Na pa'n zaw mipite tuni a an ne peuhmah hamsethuak in om hen, chi a vau bikbek hiven. Huchi in mipite abah uhi,” achi hi.
Jonathan in, "Ka pa'n mite buaisak lel ahi ve. Enta unla, khuaizu tawmchik ka chep ziak lel a ka mit ahong vak takdan.
Mipite'n gallak thil amuh peuhpeuh uh tuni in a-utut uh ne thei le uh vakzaw na tel in chia! Huaiziak in Philistiate tamsem thah louh loh i hi ve ua,” achi hi.
Huai ni in Mikmash a pan Aijalon tan in Philistia mite adou uh. Huchi in mipite abah mahmah uhi.
Mipite'n agallak thil uh aboh in aboh uhi. Belamte, bawngtalte leh bawngnoute aman ua, leitual ah athat ua, mipite'n asisan toh ane uhi.
heading: Israel Mite Khelhna

paite: "Ngai in, mipite'n sisan toh ne in TOUPA tung ah akhialta uh," chi in Saul ahilh uhi. Ama'n, "Na talekta uhi; ka ma ah suang lianpi khuk un," achi hi.

Saul in, "Mipi lak ah vakzak vek unla, akiang uah, michih in abawng hon kai hen. Michih in abelam hon kai hen. Hiai ah hong gou in ne hen. Asisan toh ne a TOUPA tung a thil hihkhial lou in, va chi un," achi hi. Huai zan in mi tengteng in amau bawngtal chiat uh ahon kai ua, huai ah agou uhi.
Saul in TOUPA a ding in maitam adoh a; huai pen TOUPA a dia maitam abawl masakpen ahi.

Saul in, "Zan chiang in Philistia mite va dou unla, zing khovak tan in i sual ding uh. Kuamah i hawi kei ding uh," achi hi. Amau, "Hoih na sak peuhmah hih in," achi uh. Siampu in ahihleh, "Pathian naih ni," achi hi.
Saul in Pathian adong a, "Philistia mite ka va sual diam? Israelte khut ah amaute na pe diam?" achi hi. Himahleh huai ni'n adawng kei.
Saul in, "Nou mipi heutu tengteng hong nai dih ua. Tuni in akoi pen ah ahia i khelh uh theihkhiak tum dih uh.
Israelte hondam zelpa TOUPA ahin lai teng ka tapa Jonathan hilhial in ana hihkhelhleh amah asih ngeingei ding ahi,” achi hi. Himahleh mipi lak a mi kuamah adawng himhim a-om kei uh.
Israel tengteng kiang ah, "Noute atuam in omkhawm unla, kei leh ka tapa Jonathan atuam in ka omkhawm ding uh," achi hi. Mipite'n Saul kiang ah, "Hoih na sak bang in hih in," achi uhi.
Saul in TOUPA Israelte' Pathian kiang ah, "Adiktak hon hihlang in," achi a, aisan pen Jonathan leh Saul tung ah apuk a; mipite bel ahul uhi.
Saul in, "Kei leh ka tapa kikal ah aisan un," achi hi. Huchi in Jonathan tung ah apuk hi.
Saul in Jonathan kiang ah, "Bang ahia na hih hon hilh in," achi hi. Jonathan in ahilh a, "Ka chiang tawi mong in khuaizu neuchik ka na chiam hi. Ngai in, ka sih ding mah ahi," achi hi.
Saul in, "Pathian in ahihhih in hih mai hen. Huai sang a thupizaw in leng. Jonathan, na si ngeingei ding ahi," achi hi.

Mipite'n Saul kiang ah, "Israelte lak a hiai hotdamna thupi mahmah hihpa Jonathan asi dia hia? Si lou hial ding. TOUPA ahin lai teng asamzang khat leng lei ah ake het kei ding. Tuni in Pathian toh asemkhawm uhi," achi uh. Mipite'n Jonathan ahondam ua, asi kei hi.
Saul in Philistia mite adelh lai akiksanta a, Philistia mite amau om mun ah apaita uhi.
Saul in Israelte tung ah vaihawmna ala a, aning teng ah amelmate, Moab, Ammon suante, Edom, Zobah kumpipate leh Philistia mite adou a; akiheina peuh ah avualzou zel hi.
heading: Saul Vaihawmna Leh Inkuante

paite: Hangsantak in gal adou a, Amalekte azou a, alok mite khut a pan Israelte ahonkhia hi.
Saul tapate bel Jonathan, Ishvi leh Malki-shua ahi ua, atanu nihte min hiaite ahi; a-upazaw min Merab ahi a, anaupangzaw min Mikal ahi.
Saul zi min Ahinoam ahi a, amah Ahimaaz tanu ahi. Asepaih heutu min Abner ahi a, amah Saul paneu Ner tapa ahi.
Saul pa Kish ahi a, Abner pa Ner bel Abiel tapa ahi.
Saul damsung teng in Philistia mite toh nakpitak in akidou uhi. Saul in mihat leh hangsan amuh peuhmah anuai a sem ding in ala zel hi.
